svg.title: SenseBridge knowledge graph
svg.desc: 340 of the most connected symbols in the SenseBridge repository, laid out as a force-directed graph and joined by 679 extracted relationships — imports, calls, definitions, and references. Nodes are coloured by subsystem: app · Swift/SwiftUI, website · Astro, docs, tools · scripts · CI, audits · legal · models · security, root orientation docs. The 16 most connected are named. This is the still version, shown when the reader prefers reduced motion. Generated by tools/graph-visual.mjs from the Graphify knowledge graph at commit d736b03.
